formattedAddress: 110, Taiwan, Taipei City, Xinyi District, Futai Village, Section 5 of Zhongxiao East RoadSection 5 of Zhongxiao E Rd, 297號B1F

text.text: This place is unique and special. The staff and bartender are extremely nice. The drink menu is original and unique. There is live performance every day which is perfect for date night or hanging out with friends. Highly recommend for everyone. Amazing experience for touring Taipei. Only downside is it’s slightly busy and reservation is highly recommended.

text.text:
Went there with my family for a Taiwanese Hokkien singer performance and some light bites.

I really liked their handmade bean curd rolls, which were filled with chives, coriander, and shrimp.

We also had the sous vide duck breast, turnip cake with salted egg yolk, and braised pork ears.

The duck breast was a bit dry and the texture was too firm. The turnip cake was good, while the pork ears were a bit too oily and salty.

We also ordered some drinks. As for cocktails, I’d say they were mediocre. I’d recommend going for hard liquor or beer instead.

The vibe was great, and the service was excellent.

text.text: Prices are reasonable but the food is just so-so. The waiter(see attached pic) who served us wasn’t friendly, bad service! Overall, not a very good experience. Probably won’t return.

text.text: Great band but terrible service. We went half an hour past our booking and they gave away our table which is understandable. They had a few empty tables but the male receptionist with shaggy hair claimed that they were all booked. We were willing to wait to see if they would be available but he said they will definitely come even though it was 11pm. Final snide remark that they do not sell standing tickets and so we left.
